summary_1line: Garuda carries Galava eastward at overwhelming speed; Galava laments his impossible vow, and after resting they meet the ascetic Sandili who curses Garuda’s wings to fall.

image_candidates.scene_text: Galava clings to Garuda’s back as the giant bird’s wings churn the oceans and fling fish and sea creatures into the air.
Garuda stands wingless like a ball of flesh on the mountain peak before the ascetic woman Sandili while Galava looks on in shock.
The radiant Garuda streaks across the sky like the rising sun while forests bend and break beneath the storm of his wings.
